verdict.rationale: uv is a local Python package and project manager CLI, not a hosted service that stores user data, so cloud data region or residency selection is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows uv offers any hosted data storage where a region could be chosen. Local cache and virtual-environment placement is a different axis and does not make this one applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
